I will do this plot much like last season, with small changes only where I can manage the cash. My maize plot is only a quarter hectare and it is rented, so I do not want to spend much on fertilizer when one bag is already too much for me unless I split it with someone. I will use improved seed because I can read the seed packet and I have seen other farmers here get better cobs with it, but I will use manure from nearby and my own labor instead of buying many chemicals.
